Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

rvis 5.16.1

  • TFD3 tables were empty on Linux and macOS: the widget files are renamed to TFD3.js and TFD3.yaml to match the widget name (file names are case-sensitive there).
  • The CRAN packages used by the wrappers are declared in Suggests.
  • Documentation website: https://genpack.github.io/rvis/.

rvis 5.16.0

  • Click events for eight more plotters: rAmCharts, c3, billboarder, visNetwork, DT (clicks on cells), dygraphs, leaflet (markers and shapes, including layers added later) and rvis coffeewheel sunbursts. rAmCharts charts are converted to htmlwidgets by rvisClickEvents().
  • Clicks on shapes under a transparent event layer, or which ignore the pointer, are found (also in the selector mode). A failure of the click javascript is logged as a console warning and never stops a chart from being shown. Dates are reported as the chart shows them.

rvis 5.15.0

  • New function rvisClickEvents(): clicks on the items of a chart (nodes, links, bars, points, slices) set the shiny input <output id>_item_click, for Graphviz (DiagrammeR and rvis grviz), networkD3, echarts4r, apexcharter, plotly and highcharter charts, and for any widget with a CSS selector. The javascript is added with htmlwidgets::onRender(): the plotting packages are not changed.
  • Dashboard outputs take the field click.events: true. New example dashboard click-events.
  • grviz charts are the grViz widget of DiagrammeR: the copied widget javascript and libraries (2.1 MB) are removed. Clicks on grviz graph nodes report the node keys.

rvis 5.14.0

  • New plotter apexcharter: bar, line, area, scatter, bubble, pie (or donut), tsline, tsarea, tsbar, heatmap and radar.
  • Plotter echarts (echarts4r): new chart types line, area, tsline, tsarea, tsbar, scatter, bubble, pie, box, heatmap, calendar, gauge, sankey, treemap, sunburst and graph (with node shapes, including ovals, and node sizes); standard settings (title, legend, tooltip, axis labels, stacking, labels, zoom, theme).
  • Examples of the new charts in the chart guides; plotter roadmap updated.

rvis 5.13.0

  • Dashboard items and clothes of type package::function (like shinyWidgets::pickerInput or shinydashboard::box) call that function with the item fields as arguments, so any function of any package can be a dashboard item. Inputs, outputs and containers are found from the function arguments; outputs are rendered by the package’s renderFoo function and inputs updated by its updateFoo function. New example dashboard generic-types.

rvis 5.12.0

  • Dashboards from YAML or JSON files or R lists: rvisDashboard(), runDashboard() and rvisDashboardExample(), with example dashboards: basic features, the apps of the Shiny gallery rebuilt from YAML, and two showcase dashboards.
  • DASHBOARD code review: the user interface is built by calling shiny functions directly, the server code is parsed once per app; new item types and settings; many bug fixes.
  • Five dashboard guides: getting started, layouts, item reference, gallery and Shiny packages.

rvis 5.11.0

  • Six chart guides with rendered examples of every chart type and plotter, each on its own R data set. Guide on the plotters covered and planned. Bug fixes found by the guides (xCharts, c3, highcharter, pivot and TFD3 charts).

rvis 5.10.x

  • 5.10.2: bundled jQuery (used by TFD3 tables) updated to 3.7.1.
  • 5.10.1: charts which were created without error but could not be shown are fixed (TFD3, coffeewheel, d3plus, echarts word clouds, knitr printing of rCharts and googleVis charts).
  • 5.10.0: code review release: bug fixes in many wrappers, faster configuration checks, clean-up.

The full history of earlier versions is in the header of file R/rvis.R and of each source file.
